title: BioGraph Steward biological assessment: aggregate summary
purpose: Descriptive public summary of completed frozen results, not a new scoring schema or evaluation protocol.
main_claim: Source-preserving graph inspection and connectivity-preserving pruning are implemented. Equal-budget comparisons show modest coassociation-retention gains over native confidence, without a general advantage over Network Enhancement or demonstrated scientific accuracy or CRC99 prediction benefit.

scope.historical_source: Qualified archived Pharos STRING v11 weighted background, anchored to December 2018 source records; separate from the current CRC99 application workspace.
scope.fixed_primary: Organism-native STRING experiments, native combined confidence secondary, canonical pair ID tie-breaker.
scope.controls: Native combined confidence and edge-masked degree product. Published Network Enhancement is an additional comparator; edge-masked MPS and transferred experimental support are exploratory.

shared_connectivity_safeguard.status: Post-exposure development policy applied equally to all six pre-existing rankings, not fresh biological confirmation.

OpenCell.assay_scope: Author-called IP-MS coassociations in HEK293T; positives only, no qualified complete negative set.

initial_frozen_figure_data_assessment.status: Original once-opened assessment preserved unchanged; later diagnostics do not replace it.

processed_author_table_QC.status: Consumed same-study source/identity QC correction, not another untouched confirmation.
processed_author_table_QC.identity_limit: Entry-family resolution is a declared sensitivity, not exact isoform, sequence, gene-of-origin or construct identification. Ambiguous or missing mappings are not negatives.
processed_author_table_QC.interpretation: Guarded primary retains 272/284 strict pairs versus 268 for native confidence and 272 for Network Enhancement; entry sensitivity is 364/385 versus 358 native and 364 NE. Unguarded original processed results remain separate. No later winner or threshold was selected.

current_Tdark_posthoc_diagnostics.scope: Captured current Pharos TDL labels, not reconstructed 2018 TDL or biological truth. Small descriptive subsets; no subgroup winner selection.
current_Tdark_posthoc_diagnostics.interpretation: Primary and native tie on both studies’ Tdark subsets; relative NE counts differ by study. No general improvement for understudied targets is established.

conditional_BioPlex_HCT116.status: Conditional CRC-cell-model author-call retention stress check; not independent truth or accuracy validation.
conditional_BioPlex_HCT116.interpretation: Guarded primary retains 247/263 versus 246/263 for native confidence and 251/263 for NE: a one-pair gain over native, with NE higher. Prior-assisted CompPASS labels and unresolved exact historical measurement chronology prevent an independent-validation claim.

CRC99_scope.interpretation: Zero eligible CRC99 pairs reflects historical source-population coverage, not biological absence or removal by temporal/exposure filters.

Complex_Portal_structural_reference.status: Completed consumed source-reader QC; unscorable for improvement because fixed coverage floor is not met.
Complex_Portal_structural_reference.interpretation: Both prior 0/24 reader failures remain preserved. Verified RCSB source-contract corrections qualified 13/24 records without relaxing biology. The final 13 eligible pairs come from one publication and every method retains all 13; no method discrimination or gain. The four original-boundary-unexposed pairs do not restore freshness after this panel was consumed.

current_workspace_interpretation_value.scope: Native bait/prey roles, unordered-pair classifier scores, tagged-ORF assay conditions and source-row provenance on pairs already represented in Pharos and STRING.
current_workspace_interpretation_value.biological_value: Tagged-expression and historical cell-model context clarify why these calls do not establish endogenous repair competence or repair restoration.
current_workspace_interpretation_value.unknowns: Exact row-level clone, allele, sequence and experimental-batch repair phenotype remain unverified. Underlying-study reuse in Pharos/STRING remains unresolved.
current_workspace_interpretation_value.review_status: Agent-assisted source/primary-literature qualification; not human-expert review or biological validation.
current_workspace_interpretation_value.native_data_redistribution: Unverified; complete native publications and derived source rows remain private research artifacts. This summary contains aggregates and commitments only.

limits: Rankings, primary, budgets and initial evaluation boundary remain frozen. Processed QC, the connectivity safeguard and structural reader corrections are consumed diagnostics, not independent confirmations.
These positive-only references cannot establish pruning precision, false-edge rates, specificity or whole-graph scientific accuracy. Undetected or unmapped pairs are not negatives.
Pair, row, bait and publication counts are not independent samples or experiment counts; no inferential p-values or confidence intervals are claimed.
The BioPlex classifier used prior STRING/GeneMANIA training labels; source calls are not independent gold-standard truth for a Pharos/STRING graph.
Historical graph retention results do not validate the current CRC workspace with 99 targets, direct binding, native/full-length construct equivalence or patient benefit.
Source-context enrichment preserves original Pharos evidence and separate candidate review states; imported records cannot validate themselves.
No model inference or new reference-driven parameter search was required for these aggregate results.
